releaseNotes:
Welcome to Night Sky 27!

Our fastest and smartest release yet.

Night Sky 27 transforms how you explore the universe with three new Aura Sky Tour experiences and major performance improvements. All designed for iOS/iPadOS 27!

- AURA SKY TOURS — TONIGHT. LIVE. ANYWHERE. (Night Sky + Aura subscription required) - Three powerful new ways to explore the universe, powered by the new Apple Foundation Models on supported devices.

- AURA TONIGHT - Discover the highlights of tonight’s sky. Aura creates a personalized spoken tour of the best stars, planets, constellations, and celestial events visible from your location tonight.

- AURA LIVE - Look up and let Aura guide you. Point your device towards the sky and receive real-time spoken guidance, helping you remain focused on the natural world instead of your screen. Interrupt the tour at any time to ask Aura questions naturally as you explore.

- AURA ANYWHERE - Travel to any place or time. Select a location, date, and time, and Aura will bring that sky to life with an intelligent tour created especially for you.

- PRIVATE, ON-DEVICE INTELLIGENCE - On supported devices, Aura Tonight, Aura Live, and Aura Anywhere use the new Apple Foundation Models. When powered by Apple Foundation Models, tour creation and interaction happen directly on your device, providing a fast and responsive experience designed with privacy at its core. Where Apple Foundation Models aren’t available—or a question requires more in-depth astronomical knowledge—OpenAI provides a fallback.

- NATURAL VOICE INTERACTION - Your Personal AI Super Astronomer now has a voice. Listen to Aura guide your tour, choose your preferred voice in Preferences, and ask questions naturally. Aura will respond aloud.

- 11 NEW LANGUAGES - Night Sky now supports Bangla, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Slovenian, Tamil, Telugu, and Urdu—making the universe accessible to even more stargazers around the world.

- AURA TOURS ON APPLE VISION PRO - Experience Aura Sky Tours in the visionOS app for an even more immersive way to explore the cosmos.

- SIRI AND SPOTLIGHT - Access Night Sky features directly through Siri with requests such as “What star is that?” or “Where is Mars?” Celestial objects are now indexed in Spotlight, making it easier to find stars, planets, constellations, and more.

- DRAMATICALLY FASTER AND LIGHTER - Night Sky now launches up to 60% faster, while its initial download size has been reduced by around 63%, from 1.23 GB to approximately 465 MB. Night Sky downloads additional content on demand only when it’s needed, so you can start exploring sooner.

- FULL APP RESIZABILITY - Night Sky’s interface now adapts beautifully as you resize the app, delivering a more flexible experience throughout.

- SAFER SKY TRACKING - When sky tracking is active, Night Sky now warns you automatically if your device is pointed directly at the Sun.

- UPDATED SPACE EXPLORATION TIMELINE - Journey through an updated timeline featuring the latest milestones in humanity’s exploration beyond Earth.

- Improved performance, stability, and reliability, together with numerous additional enhancements and bug fixes.

Enjoying Night Sky? We’d really appreciate a review on the App Store. If you need any assistance, our team will be happy to help at Support@NightSky.com.

Happy stargazing!
description:
Night Sky is a powerful AI personal planetarium.

Quickly identify stars, planets, constellations and satellites above by simply holding your iPhone, iPad or Apple Watch to the Night Sky!  This is all done magically.  Whether you’re looking for a constellation, or the International Space Station, let Night Sky direct you to it, then explore the object in AR!

FEATURE SET: 

- NIGHT SKY + AURA (Night Sky + Aura Subscription required) - Your Personal AI Super Astronomer!  Ask Night Sky Aura virtually anything about Space and it will know the answer.  Night Sky Aura fully interfaces with features within Night Sky, to direct you to objects you’re interested in, provide information on anything to do with astronomy, or even show you how the sky looks on the other side of the world!  With your own personal AI Super Astronomer right by your side, Night Sky Aura becomes the new natural way to interact with the sky above! 

- SKY TAGS - Make Night Sky yours, by adding personal Sky Tags to the map!  Pin Sky Tags to objects in the sky to save for future reference, and share them via iMessage so others can find them!  Sky Tags can be categorized, and are completely personal to you.  Maybe you want to tag a star as a memorial to someone, or tag something you’d like to observe later that night.  You can even add Astrophotography photos and observation notes to your Sky Tags!  

- CONNECTED STARGAZING (+ Feature) - Connected Stargazing is a revolutionary new feature that utilizes SharePlay in iOS 15.1, allowing you to stargaze with others when you are apart!  Start a FaceTime Audio call with those who you would like to stargaze with, then create a session by adding objects for everyone to find in the sky!

- SPATIAL AUDIO OBJECT NAVIGATION - Using AirPods Pro or AirPods Max, search for an object when automatic sky tracking is on, and Night Sky will make the star, planet or constellation ‘chirp’ in the 360° soundscape, assisting you to navigate to the object with sound!

- AR SKY WINDOW - Erase the ceiling of your bedroom, lounge or classroom with AR!  Night Sky intelligently detects the ceiling or other flat surface in a room, and can make it magically disappear to reveal the sky behind it!  

- BILLIONS OF STARS!  (+ Feature) - Space is vast, so Night Sky has been hyper charged with over 1.7 BILLION STARS streamed from the cloud!  With a new super deep zoom (greater than 10X before), prepare to delve deeper into space than you ever imagined!

- MAPS UI - A clean and familiar interface with Search features including Quick Find, intelligent Night Red Mode, Light Pollution indicator and easy to use menu, prepare to navigate Night Sky quicker than ever before!

- AR PLANETARY PORTALS & AR GRAND ORRERY (+ Features) - Step onto the surface of other planets by placing AR portals around your room!  Or walk around the entire Solar System using the newly refreshed interactive Grand Orrery!

- NIGHT SKY WATCH AR - Night Sky magically comes to life on Apple Watch, with Glass Constellations, Red Vision, and Night Sky Live Tours - all on your wrist! 

- AR OBJECT EXPLORATION  - Pull Planets, Stars and Constellations out of the sky and look at them in detailed AR!

- NIGHT SKY TOURS (+ Feature):  Get a live sky tour or create your own sky tours for any location and time in the world!  

- NIGHT SKY MINDFULNESS (+ Feature) - A mindfulness stargazing experience adding mindfulness minutes with Apple HealthKit. 

- AND MANY MORE FEATURES! 


Subscription Information: 'Night Sky +' and 'Night Sky + Aura' are available as optional subscriptions. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
